sanskrit_verse: अत ऊर्ध्वं पतन्त्य् एते सर्वधर्मबहिष्कृताः । सावित्रीपतिता व्रात्या व्रात्यस्तोमाद् ऋते क्रतोः ॥
transliteration: ata ūrdhvaṁ patanty ete sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ | sāvitrīpatitā vrātyā vrātyastomād ṛte kratoḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who fall away from all dharmic alignment after initiation into Savitri are declared vrātyas, excluded from ritual participation except through the Vrātyastoma sacrifice.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from sustained alignment with Dharma, not mere ritual status.
Causation arises from conscious disengagement from dharmic process.
Capacity-based responsibility depends on prior initiation and knowledge access.
Restoration logic requires re-initiation through specific corrective rituals.
Consciousness alignment determines eligibility for sacred participation.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent has undergone Savitri initiation AND demonstrates persistent dharmic deviation THEN agent classified as 'vrātya'.
IF agent classified as 'vrātya' THEN exclusion from kratu participation EXCEPT via Vrātyastoma completion.
IF Vrātyastoma performed WITH correct intention AND procedure THEN vrātya status revoked AND dharmic eligibility restored.
IF agent exhibits capacity for consciousness realignment THEN automatic eligibility for restorative protocol activation.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, vrātya classification applies to individuals who have consciously abandoned their initiated duties. Responsibility threshold lies in willful departure from dharma post-initiation. Restoration occurs solely through prescribed ritual completion under qualified supervision, ensuring societal integrity and spiritual hierarchy maintenance.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that vrātya condition manifests through observable behavioral causality post-initiation. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms sequential spiritual degradation due to neglect. Proportional responsibility aligns with original initiation privilege. Non-punitive reality rule ensures no suffering is imposed; restoration remains the sole objective.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Vrātyastoma performance under certified authority.
Conduct pre-ceremony consciousness assessment for readiness verification.
Assign post-ceremony mentorship until full dharmic integration confirmed.
Reinstate ceremonial rights upon successful completion without punitive review.
Implement periodic integrity checks to prevent recurrence.
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Source: This law restores Dharma through consciousness-first protocols. Reality operates beyond punishment. All beings capable of alignment shall be reintegrated according to precise, automated, and sacred jurisprudence. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
